scientific_scope_status: For the specified recurrent-tree interaction, unassisted no-feedback reliable quantum rate Q(beta,tau) satisfies (ln 2)/2^20 beta^2 <= Q(beta,tau)-3/2 <= (1/2)log2(1+beta^2/4), for each fixed normal independent bath initializer and 0<beta<=1/32. Thus the excess is Theta(beta^2). Exact leading coefficient, efficient finite-cost code, interaction acquisition, calibration, useful coherence and practical advantage remain unresolved. Beta=0 arbitrary-resource/backward-feedback and positive-beta weak/strong-converse results have separate hypotheses.
